preconditions.description: The number of students n is between 1 and 1000 inclusive.
The number of top scoring students k is between 1 and n inclusive.
The minimum score l and maximum score r are between 1 and 1000 inclusive, and l is less than or equal to r.
The total score of the top k students sk and the total score of all students sall are between 1 and 1000000 inclusive, and sk is less than or equal to sall.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly n integers.

postconditions.expression: all(l <= int(x) <= r for x in return_value.split())
postconditions.description: Each student's score is between l and r inclusive.

postconditions.expression: sum(int(x) for x in return_value.split()) == sall
postconditions.description: The sum of all students' scores is equal to sall.

postconditions.expression: sum(sorted([int(x) for x in return_value.split()], reverse=True)[:k]) == sk
postconditions.description: The sum of the scores of the top k students is equal to sk.
